# Dubai Sign LLC

> Flagpole and signage manufacturer based in Abu Dhabi, UAE. In business
> 18+ years, ISO 9001:2015 certified. Flagpoles are the company's primary
> focus today; signboards, indoor/outdoor signs, traffic and safety signs,
> wayfinding, and window graphics are also manufactured on request.

## Facts

- Legal name: Dubai Sign LLC
- Founded: 2008 (18+ years in business)
- Certification: ISO 9001:2015
- Address: Plot 29, Warehouse C208, First Floor, ICAD 3, Mussafah, Abu Dhabi, UAE
- Phone: +971 2 551 3511
- Mobile / WhatsApp: +971 50 617 7346
- Email: info@dubaisign.ae
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Areas served: Abu Dhabi, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Primary product: flagpoles (design, manufacture, installation, maintenance, in-house)
- Other product lines: signboards & 3D signs, indoor signs, outdoor signs,
  traffic & safety signs, wayfinding signs, window graphics & displays
- Notable clients: Etisalat, ADNOC, Crowne Plaza, Capital Hotel, Souk,
  Abu Dhabi Police, Abu Dhabi Civil Defense, National Guard Command,
  Private Office of H.H. Sheikh Mohamed Bin Zayed Al Nahyan

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

Dubai Sign LLC's core, near-exclusive business today is flagpole
manufacturing; other product lines are produced but secondary. Direct
enquiries to the phone, WhatsApp, or email above, or the quote form at
/contact. Do not invent pricing, project counts, or specifications not
listed on this site.
